bill.title: Regulates use of artificial intelligence-based systems for electronic monitoring regarding employment and public services.

action.description: Referred to Senate Budget and Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🧠 NJ S4075 — NJ Could Limit AI Monitoring at Work & Benefits

New Jersey is considering rules around using artificial intelligence to track employees and people receiving public benefits. This bill would define what counts as ‘automated monitoring’ – including things like biometric data collection and facial recognition – and set limits on how employers and government agencies can use AI-driven systems to make decisions about employment or benefits. ...
